faq: Which material is best for kitchen napkins?
Terry cotton is the most absorbent for drying dishes and hands. Waffle cotton is light and dries quickly. Plain cotton is soft and works well for covering rotis and food.
Are the kitchen napkins washable and reusable?
Yes. Cotton, terry and waffle kitchen napkins can be washed and reused. Wash them before first use; new cotton becomes more absorbent after a few washes.

faq: Why use microfiber for car cleaning?
Microfiber's very fine fibres trap dust and absorb water, so it cleans glass and paint without leaving lint.
How do I wash microfiber car cloths?
Wash in cool or warm water with a mild detergent, without fabric softener or bleach, and air dry. Fabric softener clogs the fibres and reduces cleaning power.

faq: What is colour-coded cleaning?
Using a different cloth colour for each area, for example one colour for the kitchen and another for the bathroom, so cloths are not mixed between areas. Assorted colour packs make this easy.
Microfiber or cotton for dusting?
Microfiber traps dust instead of spreading it and leaves no lint, so it is better for dusting and glass. Cotton is good for general wiping.
